text:
Aisha (CS): Quick hotseat capture from today's Sable onboarding — three short customer snippets that hit product. Dropping raw quotes + recommended next steps for triage.

Ben (CS): thanks — will you put these on the intake board or should I?

Aisha (CS): putting them here first so PM/eng can see context. pls tag if you need more detail.

Aisha (CS): SNIPPET 1 — Cost visibility pain"
Customer: "We had no clue why a single route spiked our bill last week. Need per-route breakdowns in the console, not just overall tokens."
Impact: blocks procurement/renewal conversations.

Riley (PM): Oof. That's a renewal risk. Is this just reporting, or do they want per-route cost allocation in invoices?

Aisha (CS): They asked for console visibility first. Invoices later if we can. High priority for this account.

Aisha (CS): SNIPPET 2 — Embedding freshness"
Customer: "Search results are stale after recent content updates — embeddings seem out of date even though ingestion succeeded."
Impact: search relevance drops, customer-facing UX complaint.

Sam (Eng): Do we know if they're using per-route embedding TTLs or a caching layer? Could be cache eviction or batching delay.

Aisha (CS): They're on our hosted API, default settings. They did multiple small updates and noticed a lag of ~12–24h.

Riley (PM): This feels like a monitoring/alert gap + UX clarification. Possible actions: document expected freshness, add hooks for immediate re-embed, or expose manual re-sync.

Aisha (CS): SNIPPET 3 — Per-route model toggle ask"
Customer: "We want to opt specific routes to smaller/cheaper model variants during peak to control costs. A per-route toggle (or policy) would help."
Impact: direct cost-savings ask; they'd adopt immediately if exposed in console or via API.

Sam (Eng): Technically feasible — config at route-level that maps to model variant. Need to evaluate rollout/permissioning. Low-to-medium effort.

Riley (PM): Okay team — can you rank 1–3 by impact/effort? Recommend we treat per-route toggle as a quick win and cost visibility as medium effort but high impact for renewals. Embedding freshness is higher risk because it affects data infra.

Aisha (CS): My priority (from customer): 1) Per-route toggle (they'll use it now) 2) Cost visibility in console (sales + renewal risk) 3) Embedding freshness (needs investigation).

Ben (CS): I'll create intake cards with those priorities and tag @Riley @Sam. Adding links to the onboarding call notes and the customer's example payload.

FeedbackBot: Created ticket CS-1421: "Per-route model toggle — Sable" and CS-1422: "Console cost visibility — Sable".

Riley (PM): Thanks — @Sam can you give a rough estimate for per-route toggle (s/hrs or days)? If it's <5 dev days we can schedule a quick spike.

Sam (Eng): Rough: spike 1d to validate config layer + auth; 2–3d for implementation + tests. If we reuse existing routing table support it's faster.

Aisha (CS): I'll feed this back to Sable and push for a pilot once we have a PR. Also capturing the renewal conversation to ensure CS/sales are aligned.

Ben (CS): tagging follow-up for next Tuesday enablement sync to demo the console option once we have a prototype. :thumbsup:

Riley (PM): Great. I'll put these on the next triage board with priority and link the onboarding recording. Thanks for the snippets — short, actionable, perfect.

Aisha (CS): cool — closing the hotseat thread. ping me if product needs more direct quotes.
